To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the linear assignment matrix is the key for the optimal transmit designs for the multiple-input multipleoutput broadcast channel with statistical CSI and that the linear assignment weighted rate upper bound is a powerful tool for the design of low complexity transmission schemes.
we derive necessary conditions for the optimal transmit beamformer design for the multiple-input multiple- output (MIMO) broadcast channel with statistical CSI at the transmitter.

the optimal transmit design for the linear assignment operation is derived under general fading conditions and an efficient algorithm is provided to achieve the optimal design; a simplified closed-form solution for a near-optimum transmit design is derived, and a low complexity transmission scheme is provided based on the closed-form solution.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the multiple-input multipleoutput broadcast channel with statistical fading channel state information at the transmitter.
the design of the transmit covariance matrices for the MIMO broadcast channel with statistical CSI.
the design of transmit precoding matrices for a multiple-antenna broadcast channel with statistical CSI at the transmitter.

we propose a low complexity transmission scheme for the MIMO broadcast channel with statistical CSI at the transmitter, which is shown to be near-optimal.
the proposed low complexity transmission scheme can be used in a practical system, and the performance is close to the optimal one.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the optimal linear assignment operation can be implemented with a simple and efficient algorithm.

the linear assignment operation can provide a near optimal design for the MIMO broadcast channel with statistical CSI, and the linear assignment weighted-sum rate maximization is a convex optimization problem.
